products.product_name: Legacy Performance Velvet Armchair by Modway
products.product_description: Introduce spirited retro-glam style into your mid-century modern or eclectic living room with the Legacy Performance Velvet Armchair. The welcoming arc of this velvet armchair's backrest is nestled in a curved gold-plated stainless steel base with vertical stretchers, creating an alluring silhouette in your entryway, dining room, or lounge space. This retro-glam accent chair makes a cozy reading corner in your bedroom. Dense foam padding and a webbed support system unite for essential comfort and durability, making the Legacy Velvet Armchair a long-lasting piece in your home. This mid-century armchair is outfitted with stain-resistant performance velvet upholstery and non-marking foot glides to protect your floors. Weight Capacity: 331 lbs
